name: o-json: build and export a restructured tree

setup.note: M opens SPLIT on the edited copy, with reshaped data in the preview. :restructure clear empties the new structure; ctrl+w h returns to the original before we copy source fields.

actions.label: Make this field an array
actions.caption: t turns title into an array of its value. Use an array when the receiving format expects a list even for one value.

actions.label: Add a grouping key above
actions.caption: O creates an empty object above title. Type metadata and esc so the new output has a place for metadata fields.

actions.label: Add a grouping key below
actions.caption: o creates an empty object below title. Type metadata and esc to reserve a named place for more output fields.

actions.label: Add a child grouping key
actions.caption: g g selects the new document root; a adds a child object. Type metadata and esc to create a grouping key inside the output.

actions.label: Undo a structure edit
actions.caption: r renames title to heading first; u restores title. Review an experiment and step back without losing the original document.

actions.label: Restore an undone edit
actions.caption: Rename title to heading, undo it with u, then ctrl+r restores heading. Compare the two names before deciding which output to keep.

actions.label: Give the new structure more room
actions.caption: L changes the page from two trees to the single layout. Focus on the new structure when its paths need more room.

actions.label: Read the split direction reminder
actions.caption: d p on the new tree shows the one-way reminder: the original is read-only. Push from the original side or obtain here when you need to bring a source shape across.

actions.label: Write the reshaped data to a new file
actions.caption: w opens an output path; type reshaped.json and enter. Export the title-only document while keeping the input intact.

actions.label: Replace an earlier output file
actions.caption: First write reshaped.json, rename title to heading, then W writes to that same output path. Refresh an export after a change without overwriting the source.

actions.label: Return to the viewer
actions.caption: q closes the restructure page and returns to the edited viewer. Inspect the output values with the shape you just built.

actions.label: Reopen the structure workspace
actions.caption: q returns to the viewer first; ctrl+w v reopens the restructure page. Continue working with the same mapping and undo history.

notes.note: e opens the file chooser; ctrl+o shows our recent sample files.
Reset point: every action begins here again; earlier actions never change this starting state.
